definitions.explanation: A traditional dance performed during the Obon festival in summer to honor the spirits of ancestors.

examples.english: There's a Bon dance in town when summer comes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧{盆踊|ぼんおど}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I wore a yukata and participated in the Bon dance.

examples.japanese: {盆踊|ぼんおど}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}わった→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧。
examples.english: I joined the circle of the Bon dance.

notes:
TIMING:
{盆踊|ぼんおど}り is performed during ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧ (Obon), typically in mid-August (or mid-July in some regions).

REGISTER:
Dancers form a circle around a raised platform (⟦{櫓|やぐら}→櫓：10646_yagura⟧) and perform synchronized movements to traditional folk songs. Each region has its own distinctive dance style.

FAMOUS DANCES:
- ⟦{阿波踊|あわおど}り→阿波踊り：noentry⟧ (Tokushima)
- ⟦{郡上踊|ぐじょうおど}り→郡上踊り：noentry⟧ (Gifu)
- ⟦{西馬音内盆踊|にしもないぼんおど}り→西馬音内盆踊り：noentry⟧ (Akita)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧: to dance the Bon dance
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}り⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: Bon dance festival
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧: Bon dance music
